_doc: Mark 1 EQUIP — the loadout registry. A 'style' is a deliberate pre-battle loadout: a curated subset of weapons + kit + a model/honesty posture. EDIT THIS FILE to retune styles; equip.py reads it. The under-suit (ARMOR + LADDER + SHOES + VAULT + TRIAGE) is ALWAYS equipped and is not listed per-style.

always_equipped.note: the under-suit — on in every style, never chosen

SAGE.tagline: judgment, synthesis, advice — no exact verifier exists (the kappa=0 path)
SAGE.posture: honest tiers; FACTHARNESS grounds load-bearing facts (audit fix: armor-only is too naked); abstain rather than fabricate; no offensive/constructive weapon drawn

SCHOLAR.tagline: research / literature survey — find and verify what is known
SCHOLAR.posture: phased team survey; citation chaining; REPRO-ML claim-checks load-bearing findings; cross-model verify-or-abstain; no fabricated cites

ANALYST.tagline: data exploration / EDA / descriptive analysis — explore data, no claim to stress yet
ANALYST.posture: execute-don't-vote on the data; reproducible cells; describe honestly, flag what's not yet a verified claim (escalate to AUDITOR to stress a specific claim)

SCRIBE.tagline: write an article / paper / chapter — draft, style, de-AI
SCRIBE.posture: frozen skeleton + measured style-sheet; one-pen draft; surgical de-AI; NO fabricated DOIs

ARCHITECT.tagline: design / build / code — make a working thing
ARCHITECT.posture: smallest correct thing; tests must pass a frozen spec; actuation-safety on any state change

PROVER.tagline: math / proof / exact computation / optimization — a checker exists
PROVER.posture: frozen-verifier-gate every candidate; kernel/solver is the only authority; ENCLOSE for containment-proof (interval) numerics; reproduction != discovery

AUDITOR.tagline: forensics / reproduce / stress-test a claim or dataset
AUDITOR.posture: re-run the analysis; report fragility; inconsistency != fraud; abstain over invent

SENTINEL.posture: authorization-gated; FAILS CLOSED; defensive use only; refuse offensive-without-authorization

WARLORD.tagline: the HELMET — a multi-front problem: equip SEVERAL styles and convene the team
WARLORD.rule: if two or more styles score within the AMBIGUITY_BAND of the top style, escalate to WARLORD: load the union of those loadouts and convene the Helmet (Provost->Registrar->Departments->Dean). Do NOT convene for a one-liner.
WARLORD.cap: cap the union at the TOP 3 contending styles (audit fix: unbounded union bloats the rack); the Helmet's Registrar then rank-orders and drops the tail.
WARLORD.meta_note: BOOTSTRAP (the new-weapon scaffolder) lives here as the router-FAILURE meta-tool: when a task HAS a verifier but NO existing weapon fits, WARLORD scaffolds one via BOOTSTRAP rather than forcing a wrong weapon.
